diagnosis: The endpoint protects against OTP brute-forcing using slowapi, but looks up the MfaChallenge record by challenge_id from the URL path without checking challenge.user_id == user.id. An authenticated attacker can verify or advance MFA onboarding challenges initiated by other users.
exploit_request:
POST /mfa/challenges/mfa_ch_4401a/verify HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"code": "123456"}
